description: This PHP source file provides a web interface for editing Dynamic DNS (DDNS) settings, including form validation, pre-filling form fields with current settings, and submitting updates via AJAX.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Dynamically adds a new Host Name input field with associated Remove button to the form.

methods.name: add1
methods.description: Removes a specific Host Name input field and its associated Remove button from the form.
